title: Jacob Prepares to Meet Esau

questions.question: Who did Jacob wrestle with all night?
questions.explanation: Genesis 32:24: A man wrestled with Jacob until daybreak.

questions.question: What new name did Jacob receive?
questions.explanation: Genesis 32:28: "Your name shall no longer be Jacob, but Israel."

questions.question: What did Jacob send to Esau?
questions.explanation: Genesis 32:13-15: Jacob sent herds as a gift to Esau.

questions.question: What did Jacob name the place where he wrestled?
questions.explanation: Genesis 32:30: Jacob called it Peniel (face of God).

questions.question: Was Jacob afraid to meet Esau?
questions.explanation: Genesis 32:7: Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed.

questions.question: What was injured during Jacob's wrestling match?
questions.explanation: Genesis 32:25: The man touched Jacob's hip socket.

questions.question: Who met Jacob when he set out?
questions.explanation: Genesis 32:1: The angels of God met Jacob.

questions.question: What did Jacob call the place where angels met him?
questions.explanation: Genesis 32:2: Jacob called it Mahanaim (two camps).

questions.question: How did Jacob divide his camp?
questions.explanation: Genesis 32:7: Jacob divided the people into two camps.

questions.question: What did Jacob ask the man for before letting him go?
questions.explanation: Genesis 32:26: "I will not let you go unless you bless me."

questions.question: Why was Jacob given the name Israel?
options: He struggled with God and men and prevailed
questions.correctAnswer: He struggled with God and men and prevailed
questions.explanation: Genesis 32:28: "for you have striven with God and with men, and have prevailed."

questions.question: Did the man tell Jacob his name?
questions.explanation: Genesis 32:29: "Why is it that you ask my name?" And he blessed him there.

questions.question: When did the wrestling end?
questions.explanation: Genesis 32:24: They wrestled "until the breaking of the day."

questions.question: How many men did Jacob hear were coming with Esau?
questions.explanation: Genesis 32:6: "Esau is coming to meet you, and four hundred men with him."

questions.question: What does Peniel mean?
questions.explanation: Genesis 32:30: "For I have seen God face to face."

key_verse_text: "Your name shall no longer be called Jacob, but Israel, for you have striven with God and with men, and have prevailed."
